summary: Uses OpenColorIO to apply color-space, file/LUT, CDL, and display/output transforms to TOP textures and images.

key_params.name: config
key_params.note: OCIO configuration containing color spaces, displays, views, transforms, and LUT references.

key_params.name: usecolorspacetransform
key_params.note: Enable conversion from input to output color space.

key_params.name: interpolation
key_params.note: File transform interpolation: nearest, linear, tetrahedral, or best.

key_params.name: filedirection
key_params.note: Apply file transform forward or inverse.

key_params.name: cdlmode
key_params.note: Disable CDL, use parameter values, or load a color correction file.

key_params.name: ccfile
key_params.note: Color correction file containing CDL values.

key_params.name: colorspace
key_params.note: Input color space for the display transform.

common_gotchas: TouchDesigner TOPs are linear; non-linear source imagery generally needs conversion to linear before linear processing.
Default transform order is Color Space, File, CDL, then Output; chain multiple OpenColorIO TOPs if a different order is needed.
File transforms do not internally handle the source color space; feed the expected color space or results will be wrong.
Several sample configs live under the TouchDesigner installation Samples/OpenColorIO folder.
Reload the config after changing external OCIO files or LUTs.
key_concepts: Uses the OpenColorIO library to apply color-space, file/LUT, CDL, and output transforms.
Default transform order is Color Space, File, CDL, then Output/Display.
Multiple OpenColorIO TOPs can be chained when a different transform order is required.
TouchDesigner TOPs are linear, so non-linear imported imagery generally needs conversion to linear.
